skill.summary: HaS (Hide and Seek) on-device text and image anonymization. Text: 8 languages (zh/en/fr/de/es/pt/ja/ko), open-set entity types. Image: 21 privacy categories...

latestVersion.changelog: fix(image): adaptive mosaic for QR codes and barcodes. Default mosaic strength aligned with QR module size, leaving codes machine-readable. Added adaptive strength, cv2 post-masking verification with escalation fallback, cv2 supplementary scan for missed codes, and cv2 type correction for YOLO misclassifications. Refactored detect-correct-filter-mask pipeline.
